title: Student V0.1 JOB 04 R3 — cross-role oracle alignment and full FAN-IN requalification
purpose: Resolve only the cross-role FAN-IN oracle ordering inconsistency exposed after R2 role convergence, then rerun the complete exact-head integration qualification without changing product semantics or frozen role code.

No Wave 2 launch, main merge, product promotion or real student use occurs inside this work package.

PR #398 live head remains exactly 249ea00b287fb98fb9ad02b8ffeff2fe2eeec670 at R3 branch creation baseline, or any later drift is explicitly classified before continuation.

Repository governance, PR scope and exact routed Learn-it Next integration CI pass on the exact executable head.

Changing runtime, presentation or authoring role implementations.
independentReview: R2 reached this boundary only after all role suites passed and the previous SVG boundary was closed.

rollback: Close the R3 PR and delete its branch. PR #398 remains frozen at its R2 evidence head; the exact R2 executable result and frozen role heads remain recoverable.
